arguments.summary: Alert for malware detection (Cobalt Strike beacon variant) on endpoint 10.0.3.15 was confirmed as a false positive. The file hash SHA256:a3f2b8c1d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1 corresponds to an authorized red team tool used in exercise RT-2026-0088. No malicious activity was found.
